items: Re-read the current TasteVal, OPPD, mechanics-status, and evidence-copy aggregation preprints before promotion. Added four bounded author-reported developments with explicit confidence and reproduction gaps. TasteVal’s full text reports average per-run costs of $282 for Opus 5.5 and $9,123 for expert baseliners under author-selected API/GPU/salary assumptions; this is not an equal-dollar comparison, and the AI-R&D forecast scenarios are expressly naive rate-transfer extrapolations. The OPPD full-text check found its own 250-problem, 16-candidate MATH500 result (79.2) slightly above OPPD (78.4), while the published 64-candidate comparison and small-budget GRPO result need protocol-aware interpretation. Its public repository README lists a shared training/evaluation harness and included data, but the code itself was not run or audited.

Rechecked the pinned OpenAI π manuscript path and arXiv Navier–Stokes Part I abstract. The PDF body for the former was unavailable; the latter explicitly leaves oscillatory-pulse cancellation to Part II, which did not surface in the bounded exact-title arXiv search. Both remain deferred for the missing proof step/review.

Rechecked South Africa’s official AI-policy sources through gov.za/DCDT. The Minister’s May budget speech confirms an expert-panel appointment and policy reintroduction as plans; no newer replacement or panel outcome surfaced in this bounded official-site search. Existing November revisit trigger remains.
Acknowledged issue:739 against its exact intake digest through its existing rejected-noise candidate; no host execution trace was accessed and the reported failure cause remains unverified.

Read and compared arXiv:2610.03087 mechanism, evaluation sections and limitations against official Mosaic Streaming and Grain documentation; identified missing implementation artifact and bounded topology guarantees.

Enumerated official arXiv cs.AI Oct 2026 list entries 201–250 of 1,192; deep-read iS-KV arXiv:2610.02815 including evaluation and appendix; audited compression/accuracy/latency scope and compared novelty with primary OjaKV source.

Rechecked official Chinese MIIT 2026 green-compute notice and departmental interpretations, extracted attributed energy/PUE/renewables/CUE rubric context, attempted exact WPS retrieval, and inspected all four pages of the 2025 official facility roster (60 names, no metrics).

Rechecked CAC digital-green policy source in Chinese; candidate alias update was blocked by canonical writer path collision, preserving the existing records and recording the reconciliation issue as debt.

Enumerated official cs.AI October entries 251–300 of 1,192 and examined arXiv:2610.03430v1 §§1–4 and Appendix G; recorded JIL as blocked pending independent reproduction, preserving its per-request white-box threat model and one-model/five-workload serving scope.

Retrieved and fully inspected the exact official MIIT 2026 green-compute WPS scoring attachment; crosswalked its 100-point weights, one-year actual measurement requirement, theoretical-FLOPS energy-intensity measure and annual value-per-IT-kWh indicator; updated the green-compute candidate and open workload-metric question.

Rechecked OpenAI’s Oct 6 math release against the official public repository README and IAS Advisory Group primary statements/recommendations; compared what is disclosed with independent community-led assessment/access recommendations and updated the release candidate with attributed boundaries. No theorem-level audit or proof build performed.

Revisited the top-priority stale Navier–Stokes development through its existing deferred audit candidate. Inspected arXiv:2609.35406v2 abstract and version metadata; established that it is explicitly an exposition of OpenAI’s profile construction, not a complete independent validation, and residual correction is deferred to Part II. The 6.36 MB full HTML exceeded browser retrieval limits; no new confidence or promotion.

Rechecked the deferred Japan data-centre-policy candidate via direct original-language ENECHO retrieval. Partial-range PDF text for §§3.2, 5.1–5.2 and 6 verifies public reporting boundaries, FY2030 average PUE target and future new-site standard; candidate disposition moved to monitoring while legal/outcome gaps remain. Updated the cross-country AI-energy-metrics question.

Retrieved MIIT attachments 2 and 3 to compare requested self-reported facility fields with the narrower recommendation-summary table; updated the policy candidate and research question with the precise publication/data boundary.

Updated the existing EU rating candidate and cross-regime question after direct Commission annex review and a targeted EUR-Lex procedure-status check. EU labels specify PUE/WUE classes and context fields; Commission adoption is confirmed but the indexed EUR-Lex record places the objection window through 21 Nov 2026, and OJ effect/implementation remain unverified.

Downloaded the official 245-page arXiv v2 Navier–Stokes Part I PDF. Inspected Theorem 1.1, conditional lower-order construction statements and final residual boundary: Part I constructs a stress-supported background with flat error under stated assumptions; authors leave oscillatory-pulse cancellation to Part II. Updated the canonical owner candidate; no detailed proof audit or reproduction.

Queried the official arXiv Atom API by the exact Part I title; only Part I v2 was returned and it itself says residual cancellation is reserved for Part II. Recorded the bounded result and retained cross-repository/alternate-title availability debt.

Targeted Japanese search of the official ENECHO FAQ surfaced the relevant original-language Q/A content. Corrected the site-area benchmark threshold to 300 m², distinguished it from the operator 1,500 kl reporting threshold, and recorded small-site disclosure exception plus unresolved low-utilization standard. Live page and underlying legal instrument remain inaccessible.

Opened the official e-Gov consultation-stage proposed order and notice PDFs for Japan and inspected the data-centre reporting table and benchmark pages. Draft fields include facility electricity, PUE, design PUE, non-fossil shares and utilization with operator/site thresholds; cover pages retain blank promulgation number/date, so final legal force remains unverified. This draft comparison also helped catch and correct the 300 m² site-threshold transcription.

Retrieved the current Japanese e-Gov consolidated Energy Conservation Act Enforcement Regulation, inspected its amendment history and Article 35(4): Ordinance No.81 (26 Dec 2025) effective 1 Apr 2026, No.59 (1 Jul 2026) effective the same day, and DC plan-attachment requirements. Exact text of No.59 and benchmark notification still need comparison.

Ran exact-title and author lookup for Part II on Fudan Mathematics pages, arXiv and in Chinese; no official matching result surfaced. Kept the Part II availability search open and did not use secondary explainers as evidence.

Reconciled authorized issue:739 snapshot (exact digest) with existing candidate owner; writer retained actual rejected_noise disposition. Cause of reported executor failure remains unverified; no host log accessed.

Advanced Brazil REDATA policy candidate using Lei 15.504/2026 Art. 11-B and targeted Receita Federal Normas API search for Redata in 2026-09-15–2026-10-07; zero indexed acts returned, while MDIC/Fazenda/Diário Oficial and implementation outcomes remain open.

Rechecked Clay official Navier–Stokes announcement and active-problem listing; preserved apparent-settlement vs no final adjudication boundary. Queried arXiv author/title results for Zhen Lei/NS; known Part I appeared, no distinct Part II result, with alternate-author/repository coverage still open.
Guarded candidate writer reclassified the duplicate NS audit alias to duplicate_of CAND-2026-10-07-15E80A95; updated identity owner with exact status and search locators.

Crosswalked Brazil Lei 15.504/2026 Art. 11-B thresholds and annual public sustainability-report requirements into Q-2026-10-07-DATACENTER-AI-ENERGY-METRICS using the guarded question writer; separated statutory observability design from realized outcome, useful-AI-output, quality and cost evidence.

Rechecked ARC Prize Astra analysis, verified results table and testing policy. The official source still distinguishes 62.71% Standard from 99.95% Provider Adapter and provides per-task replays; broader leaderboard gained newer rows but Astra’s result was unchanged. No material canonical development revision warranted.

Added a second official Portuguese-source implementation crosscheck to the Brazil REDATA candidate: MDIC says key criteria remain delegated to regulation; Fazenda’s limited publication index lists only the earlier March parecer for REDATA. Kept the implementation gap open and narrowed next action to Diário Oficial and MDIC/Fazenda normative-act registries.

Attempted official DOU exact-term REDATA search for post-law implementation; endpoint was inaccessible from this execution environment, persisted blocked receipt, and left the DOU absence question open.

Inspected CAC-hosted original-language China 2026–2030 digital-green transition plan at lines 47, 52, 59–60, 102; created deferred guarded candidate CAND-2026-10-07-CHINA-DIGITAL-GREEN-TRANSITION and linked the policy target/disclosure design to the cross-country datacenter metrics question. No compliance/outcome inference; implementation evidence remains open.

Historical backfill: inspected NCAC 2025 digital-green report (hosted by Hunan government), which reports 246 National Green Data Centers at end-2024 and a Qinghai center monitoring 17,000 servers, 3,627 PFLOPS and 12.9 MW. Added source locators and official-claim/no-independent-audit/no-useful-work-denominator caveats to deferred China candidate and cross-country metrics question.
Compared Chinese NDRC/NEA multi-user green-power rules with Hunan implementation criteria and scoped the 105-project/34.7-GW aggregate; no attribution to the new policy or compute outcomes inferred.

Triangulated Datang Zhongwei PV/wind project status and Hunan Zhiliang Xinghe project records; retained unknown commissioning, renewable supply and measured workload/economics. Updated the canonical cross-country energy-metrics question.

Read the OpenAI Navier-Stokes Lean comparator wrappers, exact challenge axioms, metadata, and C/D theorem bridges; identified the formalized route and left independent compilation, semantic audit and PDE review unresolved.

Deepened the cross-country facility energy question with original-language MIIT 2026 green-compute screening thresholds, score weights, electricity-carbon allocation rules, and explicit distinction between screening criteria and measured AI workload outcomes.

Crosswalked MLPerf system-level benchmark energy methodology against current v6.1 public results: all 492 summary rows have has_power=false and the complete 46,533-path public tree has no PTD/power-log filenames; preserved the possibility of differently named/external/private artifacts and did not equate design_power_watts with measured energy.

items: CAND-2026-06-12-A91C37E5 — HarnessX reports large cross-benchmark gains from evolving typed agent harnesses, creating a useful contrast with HARNESSEVO's localized-credit result — revisit if: Independent reproduction appears, a paper-tagged release or exact benchmark/evolution manifests are published, or matched controls separate model/backbone, harness composition, adaptation compute, verifier leakage and component-level credit.

CAND-2026-07-15-CHINA-ANTHROPOMORPHIC-AI-RULES — China's dedicated anthropomorphic-AI interaction rules enter force with dependency, manipulation and minor-protection duties — revisit if: CAC or other agencies publish enforcement cases, implementing standards, safety-assessment guidance, filing data or interpretations affecting agent memory/personalization/autonomy.

CAND-2026-08-02-EU-AI-ACT-ENFORCEMENT — EU AI Act enters an enforcement phase for GPAI and transparency obligations — revisit if: Commission enforcement actions, GPAI guidance updates, Code-of-Practice implementation evidence, complaints/decisions or material court/regulator interpretations appear.

CAND-2026-08-02-EU-GPAI-ENFORCEMENT — European Commission enforcement powers for general-purpose AI model obligations enter application — revisit if: The Commission announces a first GPAI enforcement action, systemic-risk notification decision, serious-incident proceeding, fine, or material interpretive update.

CAND-2026-08-18-FDA-GENAI-MEDICAL-DEVICES — FDA opens competency-based regulatory framework discussion for generative-AI medical devices — revisit if: FDA publishes docket comments, workshop material, draft/final guidance, legal-authority analysis or concrete submission expectations before the deadline.

CAND-2026-08-26-ANTHROPIC-CVD-SCALE — Anthropic's disclosure ledger shows AI-assisted vulnerability discovery scaling to thousands of human-reviewed findings — revisit if: The dashboard materially changes, per-model discovery attribution/cost is released, or independent organizations publish matched AI-versus-human vulnerability-discovery throughput.

CAND-2026-08-26-AWS-NVIDIA-2M-GPU-EXPANSION — AWS and NVIDIA plan 2 million additional Blackwell Ultra/Rubin-class GPUs across 2027–2028 — revisit if: AWS discloses installed/deployed counts, Rubin instances reach GA, procurement/power buildout data appears, or timelines materially change.

CAND-2026-08-31-3C91A8D4 — European Commission designates ChatGPT a Very Large Online Search Engine under the Digital Services Act — revisit if: The Commission publishes the designation decision, compliance deadline, systemic-risk requirements, audit/researcher-access details, enforcement actions or OpenAI implementation changes.

CAND-2026-08-31-4F2C8E11 — EuroHPC signs €387.8M AMD MI430X LUMI-AI contract for 2027 deployment — revisit if: EuroHPC/CSC publish accelerator counts, peak/sustained AI performance, access policy or deployment milestones; installation begins; or the contract/system architecture materially changes.

CAND-2026-08-31-54C150C8 — China MIIT launches national AI application-service-provider cultivation action — revisit if: MIIT publishes the national resource pool, procurement/compute-support figures, standards, adoption results, provider lists, or measurable model/agent deployment outcomes.

CAND-2026-08-31-5BE9E260 — Signal: draft IPO documents reportedly show a $5.5B OpenAI warrant position in SB Energy as AI infrastructure financing deepens — revisit if: SB Energy IPO filing, SEC document, OpenAI/SoftBank/NVIDIA statement, audited financing document, or additional independent reporting confirms or contradicts the warrant and guarantee details.

CAND-2026-08-31-A11F0A7E — Maniformer reports a million-hour multimodal human-interaction corpus and 20,000-device collection fleet for Physical AI — revisit if: Public dataset slices, model/data cards, independent quality audits, VLA scaling curves, privacy/consent documentation, customer training results or cross-embodiment transfer measurements appear.

CAND-2026-08-31-A1C3550A — HUMAIN puts AMD MI355X/Cisco AI infrastructure into production in Saudi Arabia and targets a much larger sovereign compute buildout — revisit if: Installed accelerator count, power draw, acceptance benchmark, pricing, customer workload metrics, independent utilization data, MI400 phase commissioning, or sovereign-AI procurement documents appear.

CAND-2026-08-31-AGENT-CAPABILITY-COST-EVAL — Agent capability-cost evaluation: cheaper failure is not a Pareto win, and run provenance is load-bearing — revisit if: A larger attempt-linked dataset, repeated trials, pinned model/tool configurations or independent harness comparisons appear.

CAND-2026-08-31-C43E30F0 — China's Intelligent Chemical Model 3.0 Pro moves a vertical model toward tool-executing chemical-engineering workflows — revisit if: Technical report, benchmark protocol, model/data card, reproducible agent tasks, pilot-plant closed-loop results, safety/audit details or independent industrial evaluation appears.

CAND-2026-08-31-CHINA-NATIONAL-AI-COMPUTE-SCALE — China reports 2.45 million PFLOPS FP16 of national intelligent-compute capacity and expanding centralized scheduling — revisit if: National Data Administration publishes methodology, accelerator inventory/utilization, energy data, task-level scheduling statistics, or independent capacity estimates suitable for cross-country comparison.
CAND-2026-08-31-CN-AI-APPLICATION-SERVICE-PROVIDERS — China MIIT launches national AI application-service-provider program with explicit demand-side procurement support — revisit if: new evidence

CAND-2026-08-31-CONFIDENCE-CHANNEL-DIVERGENCE — Linguistic confidence is a lossy and poorly calibrated channel for internal model confidence — revisit if: Independent reproduction, stronger black-box calibration methods, or adaptive-compute/agent-routing studies compare verbal confidence against internal or ensemble uncertainty at matched cost.

CAND-2026-08-31-CXMT-HBM4-SIGNAL — Signal: CXMT reportedly begins small-scale HBM4 production — revisit if: CXMT or a named customer confirms HBM4 shipments/specifications, teardown/benchmark evidence appears, packaging partners disclose volume, or multiple independent sources corroborate yield and scale.

CAND-2026-08-31-EU-CHATGPT-VLOSE — European Commission designates ChatGPT a Very Large Online Search Engine under the DSA — revisit if: Commission publishes the designation decision, compliance deadlines, systemic-risk assessment, audit requirements, data-access measures, enforcement action or OpenAI implementation details.
